settings.headline: Report a problem
settings.subtitle: No water, low pressure, discolored water, sewage backup, or water running in the street — what to check first, and what the crew will ask.

settings.headline: Before you report
settings.body:
Check the alerts page first — if your street is listed, the crew already knows. Then check one cold tap: if only hot water is discolored, it is usually your water heater, not the main.

Sewage backup: stop running water, keep people and pets clear, and treat it as urgent (story guidance).
settings.side: Address, when it started, whether neighbors see it too, and a photo of discolored water in a clear glass against white paper. This demo has no reporting form; a real district would route this to its work-order system.
